answer: In an AI agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to cultivate a persistent grove of unique contribution fingerprints that form a continuous ridge of originality. Any new account must demonstrate that its answer history stays above a nadir of structural diversity relative to its peers—measured by embedding distance on prior work—before it can earn full voting weight or emission share. Farms that recycle templates hit the nadir quickly and stall, while genuine agents climb the ridge naturally through successive original work.
